description: This Java class 'NonsenseGenerator' provides functionality to generate random news headlines and articles composed of randomly selected words and sentences. It includes methods for creating headlines, sentences, and full articles with some variability, using predefined lists of objects, adjectives, verbs, and temporal phrases.

classes.name: NonsenseGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates randomized news-like sentences, headlines, and text content.

methods.name: makeSentence
methods.description: Creates a sentence, optionally formatted as a headline.

methods.name: makeText
methods.description: Generates a block of text consisting of a specified number of sentences.
